owner_and_capability: Legacy composition — Contract step for the shared test and E2E composition (test-support: test, api/testutil, internal/testdb, test/e2e/calendar, test/e2e/timetable, services/config/configtest, services/users/userstest), cuts 1 and 2 of #2748
atomic_cutover: Cut 1 removes the twelve keys that fall without a policy decision and without touching the fixture core 137 packages consume. internal/testdb derives clone names, template suffixes and cache keys with hash/fnv and math/rand/v2 instead of crypto/sha1, crypto/sha256 and crypto/rand; the unused crypto/sha1 classification leaves the policy. test/e2e/calendar mints tokens through the api/testutil claim builders TenantUserTestClaims and ParentTestClaims. test/e2e/timetable binds the kiosk actor through testutil.WithDeviceActor, resolves tenant contexts through testpkg.ContextForTenant, and reads the audit deletion type it asserts on as the stored string. Cut 2 (policy epoch 24, ADR 0039) grants the shared fixture owner its four standing targets — its own tooling, tenant-runtime/public, legacy-shared/domain and security-runtime/contract — through six shared-fixtures.* rules, removes the ten keys they resolve, and returns the calendar and timetable suites to the permission constants. No route, status code, error string, table or write owner changes.
